Title: Anomalous Abilities Registration Ordinance
Description: People with anomalous abilities must register with the city. Unregistered public use becomes an offence.

Title: Bayou Flood Control Bond
Description: Borrow to raise levees and widen drainage on the east side.

Title: Post-Isadora Property Tax Relief
Description: Lower the property tax rate for three years.

Title: Public Safety Sales Tax
Description: Raise the city sales tax to fund police and fire.

Title: Neighbourhood Rent Stabilization
Description: Cap annual rent increases in residential districts.

Title: Community Policing Reform
Description: Civilian oversight and de-escalation training; slower but more trusted responses.

Title: Youth Curfew
Description: Minors off the streets between 23:00 and 05:00.

Title: Port Expansion and Channelside Redevelopment
Description: Fast-track permits for development along the ship canal.
